about_the_game:
Objective

Light up those peepers and hop your way out of this gloomy well!

Key Features

A Platformer That Doesn’t Mess Around

  • No enemies, no deaths—just pure, unfiltered challenge.

  • Your skill and patience are the only things standing between you and glory.

See Through the Shadows

  • Navigate a dark world where your froggo’s glowing eyes light the way.

  • Right-click to peek ahead—those peepers are your trusty guide!

Slingshot-Style Jumping Shenanigans

  • Pull back and launch your frog like a slingshot—boing!

  • Fine-tune your jumps with a crouch animation that shifts pixel-by-pixel and over 10 frames of glorious control.

  • Go for a short, safe hop, yank hard for a wild leap, or angle it just right to thread the needle through tight gaps—the possibilities are endless.

  • A slick physics engine means every tweak changes your fate, letting you tackle the same platform in a dozen dazzling ways.

  • Sketch thousands of jump arcs with your fingertips and nail that perfect landing.

Adorable Star of the Show

  • Pixel-art so cute it’ll make you forget how many times you’ve faceplanted into the abyss.

  • A lovable frog buddy on a hardcore adventure.

Sing When the Going Gets Tough

  • Mid-struggle, treat yourself to your frog’s “ribbit ribbit” serenade—available on demand!

  • Feeling beat? Belt out a tune and take a breather.

  • Messed up? No sweat—kick back and regroup.

About the Game

Welcome to JumFrog—a relentless gauntlet of challenges where even the tiniest slip-up can send you plummeting. This isn’t for the faint of heart; it’s a brutal test of skill that’ll push you to your limits. But oh, the sweet, sweet taste of victory? Worth every heart-pounding second. Every jump’s a thrill, every misstep a potential disaster—talk about an adrenaline rush that’ll keep you hooked.

But hold up, there’s more to this than just hopping around. Where’d this crown-wearing frog come from? Why’s it snowing inside a well? What’s waiting beyond the walls this little guy’s so desperate to escape? And most importantly—what’s the deal with this mysterious pit? Buckle up, because this journey’s got questions galore.

Gameplay

In JumFrog, every jump is make-or-break. One wrong move, and all your hard work could croak in an instant. But don’t let that scare you off! Every fall’s a lesson, every retry a chance to sharpen your skills. You’ll curse, you’ll cheer, and you’ll come out tougher than ever.

Hop in and see if you’ve got what it takes to escape the well—or at least figure out why there’s a frog with a crown stuck in there!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: Ribbit ribbit! Everything’s pitch-black around here—where the heck am I? Gotta bounce my way outta this mess! Eyes wide open, it’s time to scope out the next foothold. Adjust your power with the mouse and leap—but seriously, why am I even trapped here… ribbit?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Polish, Korean
